name: Spiritus Natalis: A String Quartet Concert with Adlib Strings
description: Adlib Strings play a Christmas programme of classical pieces and traditional melodies at Igreja dos Clérigos, with projections by OCUBO. Saturday 26 December at 21:00, tickets from €24.
longDescription:
If you missed the earlier dates, Spiritus Natalis has one more after Christmas. The string quartet Adlib Strings play classical pieces mixed with traditional Christmas melodies inside Igreja dos Clérigos, with festive video projections by OCUBO moving across the Baroque walls.

The church's acoustics are close and intimate, which suits four strings well. The concert is recommended for ages 12 and up. Photos and video are fine during the performance, but no flash.

It takes place on Saturday 26 December at 21:00 at Igreja dos Clérigos, Rua de São Filipe de Nery. Tickets start at €24. Doors open 15 minutes before the concert and there's no waiting area inside.
